mapper.insert: insert into throw_skill (uuid, agent_id, map_id, skill_index, skill_icon_x, skill_icon_y, agent_icon_x, agent_icon_y) values (#{uuid}, #{agentId}, #{mapId}, #{skillIndex}, #{skillIconX}, #{skillIconY}, #{agentIconX}, #{agentIconY})
mapper.select:
select * from throw_skill INNER JOIN skill_collect on throw_skill.uuid = skill_collect.skill_uuid and throw_skill.map_id = #{mapId} and throw_skill.skill_index = #{skillIndex} and throw_skill.agent_id = #{agentId} and skill_collect.username=#{username} INNER JOIN skill_content on skill_content.uuid = throw_skill.uuid
and skill_content.side=#{side}
mapper.insert: insert into throwground_skill (uuid, agent_id, map_id, skill_index, skill_icon_x, skill_icon_y, agent_icon_x, agent_icon_y) values (#{uuid}, #{agentId}, #{mapId}, #{skillIndex}, #{skillIconX}, #{skillIconY}, #{agentIconX}, #{agentIconY})
mapper.select:
select * from throwground_skill as skill INNER JOIN skill_collect as collect on skill.uuid = collect.skill_uuid and skill.map_id = #{mapId} and skill.skill_index = #{skillIndex} and skill.agent_id = #{agentId} and collect.username=#{username} INNER JOIN skill_content as content on content.uuid = skill.uuid
and content.side=#{side}
mapper.insert: insert into line_skill (uuid, agent_id, map_id, skill_index, group_x, group_y, angle) values (#{uuid}, #{agentId}, #{mapId}, #{skillIndex}, #{groupX}, #{groupY}, #{angle})

insert into control_skill (uuid, agent_id, map_id, skill_index, skill_icon_x, skill_icon_y, point_list) values (#{uuid}, #{agentId}, #{mapId}, #{skillIndex}, #{skillIconX}, #{skillIconY}, #{pointList,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler})
